defaults.video_script: In twenty twenty one his father drowned in a lake back home. He flew to Brazil, buried him, and came back. Weeks later he scored a header to save Liverpool's season. Which makes you wonder,
defaults.video_subject: Alisson Becker's father Jose Agostinho Becker drowned in a lake near the family home in Brazil in February 2021. Alisson returned to Liverpool and in May 2021 scored a 95th-minute header against West Bromwich Albion, the first goal of his career, which kept Liverpool's Champions League qualification hopes alive, and he dedicated it to his father
